mission.goal: Provide a secure, evidence-aware Gemini connector and reusable EvidenceOps transcription foundation.
mission.workflow: Private request -> validation -> one provider -> normalized evidence envelope -> immutable operational proof.
mission.data: Text prompts, inline audio or gs:// locators, transcript outputs and non-content operational metadata.
mission.stack: Node.js 22 ESM, native HTTP/fetch, Docker, Cloud Run, Vertex AI or Gemini Developer API, GitHub Actions WIF.
mission.environment: Local test runtime and target Google Cloud project sov-hybrid-suite in africa-south1.
mission.governance: Formation permit per consequential action, single effectful GitHub WIF deployment path, truthful state separation.
mission.failure: Fail closed on invalid input, authorization, configuration, limits, identity, timeout and upstream failures.
mission.testing: Native Node unit/integration/smoke tests with fake providers and failure-first cases.
mission.deployment: Manual WIF workflow, read-only preflight, explicit confirmation, private zero-traffic canary, authenticated health proof, optional promotion.
mission.continuity: Body-bound idempotency, bounded in-memory checkpoints, Local Bible handoff and explicit stop signals.

classification.data_sensitivity: Potential legal evidence and personal information
classification.external_effects: Gemini API calls and optional Cloud Run deployment
classification.authority_class: A1 local build; A2 repository publication and deployment
classification.cost_boundary: Zero cost for local build; cloud inference or deployment requires separate verified authorization

assumptions.stack: Node.js 22 and the native fetch implementation conform to the tested interfaces.
assumptions.runtime: The existing GitHub WIF provider and named service accounts are configuration claims until live preflight readback succeeds.
assumptions.storage: Callers provide controlled inline bytes or a permitted gs:// object; the connector persists no source media.
assumptions.authentication: Cloud Run remains private, IAM is the primary caller perimeter, and the runtime service account must independently possess Vertex prediction permission.
assumptions.deployment: Billing, API enablement, Artifact Registry, runtime IAM and deployer authority must all pass live preflight before deployment.
assumptions.evidence: Model-generated transcripts require human verification before evidentiary reliance.

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: connector exposes a JSON API; a reviewer UI is a designed future component.
components.backend: Node.js native HTTP request handler with provider, validation and evidence modules.
components.database: NOT_APPLICABLE: v0.1 is stateless; persistent idempotency and case data are explicitly designed future features.
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: v0.1 rejects overload; asynchronous queueing is explicitly designed.
components.worker: In-process bounded request executor with concurrency and daily limits.
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: no scheduled work in v0.1.
components.cache: In-memory TTL idempotency cache and short-lived metadata access-token cache.
components.storage: Caller-controlled inline bytes or generation-pinned future Cloud Storage; connector persists no source content.
components.authentication: Private Cloud Run IAM, optional shared bearer secret, Vertex service identity or Developer API auth key.

architecture.effectful_path: GitHub workflow_dispatch -> WIF deployer -> Artifact Registry/Cloud Run zero-traffic canary -> authenticated readback -> optional promotion.

observability.correlation_ids: Safe inbound or generated x-request-id returned and logged.
observability.health_checks: Separate liveness and configuration readiness endpoints plus canary health proof.
observability.structured_logs: JSON logs with secret/audio redaction and route, status, duration and provider fields.
observability.audit_logs: GitHub Actions, WIF and Cloud Audit Logs are external audit layers; application logs record bounded decisions.
observability.metrics_alerts: Local counters implemented; external SLO alerts remain DESIGNED and are not claimed.

failure_modes.AUTHORIZATION_FAILURE: Return 401 for shared-token failure; Cloud Run IAM denies outside the container.
failure_modes.TIMEOUT: Abort provider request and return normalized 504.
failure_modes.PARTIAL_WRITE: No persistent application write; only completed responses enter the idempotency cache.
failure_modes.MISSING_CONFIGURATION: Startup or readiness fails without required provider identity configuration.
failure_modes.EXTERNAL_API_FAILURE: Return normalized 4xx/502 without credential echo or silent provider fallback.

testing.unit: Provider authentication, endpoint construction, validation, integrity and error normalization tests.
testing.integration: Ephemeral HTTP server tests for routes, auth, limits, idempotency, quota and concurrency.
testing.e2e_or_smoke: Dependency-free local smoke script proves health and generation envelope through a fake provider.
testing.fixtures_mocks: Deterministic fake Gemini provider and fetch responses; no paid external call.
testing.failure_first: Invalid JSON, oversize body/audio, bad token, non-allowlisted model, concurrency, quota, idempotency conflict and provider denial.

delivery.file_tree: README, package manifest, src modules, tests, scripts, Dockerfile, Cloud Run manifest, GitHub workflow, docs and BUILD_CONTRACT.
deploy_commands: Use the manual Kim DataVerse Gemini Connector GitHub workflow with preflight before deploy.
rollback_commands: gcloud run services update-traffic kim-dataverse-gemini-connector --project sov-hybrid-suite --region africa-south1 --to-revisions PREVIOUS_REVISION=100
delivery.debugging: Use x-request-id across application JSON logs, GitHub job logs and Cloud Audit Logs; never log prompt, audio or credentials.

formation.effectful_permit: NOT_APPLICABLE: current contract covers authorized reversible local implementation; deployment requires a new single-use A2 permit.

watchman.cancellation_behavior: Abort current provider request where possible, do not promote traffic, preserve logs and previous revision.

continuity.idempotency: TTL key plus canonical body hash; conflicting reuse returns 409.
continuity.checkpoints: Completed response cache locally; workflow revision and provider readbacks externally; immutable Local Bible transaction for handoff.
continuity.resume_conditions: Resume only from a matching mission version, verified source tree and last complete Local Bible transaction.
continuity.stop_switch: SIGTERM/SIGINT locally; workflow cancellation before promotion; Formation stopRequested gate for subsequent actions.

proof.semantic_verification: Local fake-provider smoke proof confirms health and generation response semantics without a paid call; live Gemini semantics remain unproven.
unresolved_defects: Provider-side WIF, billing, IAM, live Gemini and deployment readbacks have not run
